title: Return Link Limit in Dating a Completed Cycle (Occupancy and Residency Certification)
content:
In dating a completed certification cycle on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile, the **return link limit** rests on two facts: whether a return notice — an accepted return-home notice about the primary borrower — is on file, and whether the profile shows no absence start date.

| Return notice on file | Profile shows no absence start date | Return link limit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 30 days |
| yes | no | 14 days |
| no | yes | 14 days |
| no | no | zero days |
